name: ActivityLog
description: Permanent record of what happened to an item: who did what, when. Entries are never edited.

entity_type.description: Kind of record: InventoryItem, BorrowedItem, RentalOrder, Location …

record_id.description: Id of the record the entry is about

record_name.description: Name of the record at the time

record_code.description: UID or tag number at the time

action.description: created, updated, deleted, checked_in, returned, moved, status_changed, condition_changed, rented_out, rental_returned, audited, audit_completed, tag_printed …

related_id.description: Related record, e.g. the rental order or audit
